final_message:
Fixed. `wrap()` in `src/wrap.py` had an off-by-one: it checked `> width - 1`, so a line of exactly `width` characters got split. I changed it to `> width`. `test_wrap_exact_width` was the failing test, and all 5 tests now pass.

You didn't say what "isn't working" meant, so I went by the failing test. If you were seeing something else, tell me what you expected.
